documents.title: Returns
documents.text:
## Change-of-mind returns
You can return an item within 14 days of delivery if you changed your mind. The item must be unused, clean and in
its original box with all accessories and the warranty card.
## Exchanges
If you want another colour or model instead, choose "exchange" when you book the return. We ship the new item
when the old one reaches our warehouse. If the new item costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we
refund the difference.
## Items that cannot be returned
Filters, vacuum bags and other parts that touch food or dust cannot be returned once the packet is open. Items
sold as "final sale" in the shop cannot be returned either, unless they are faulty.
## Pickup and refund
Book the return in your account and a courier collects the item from your address. From 10 October 2026 return
shipping is free. The refund goes back to the original payment method within 7 working days after the item
reaches our warehouse.

documents.title: Damaged or faulty items
documents.text:
## Check the box at delivery
Look at the box in front of the driver. If it is crushed, wet or open, take a photo and write it on the delivery
note, or refuse the parcel: we send a new one at no cost.
## Report the problem
If an item arrives damaged or stops working, report it within 7 days of delivery in your account or by phone.
Add a photo or a short video of the problem if you can.
## Missing parts
If a part or an accessory is missing from the box, report it within 7 days. We send the missing part by express
delivery, free of charge, usually within 3 working days.
## Replacement or refund
Company X collects the item free of charge. We ship a replacement within 5 working days after the item reaches
our warehouse. If you prefer, we refund the full price instead, including the delivery fee.
## After 7 days
Problems reported more than 7 days after delivery go to the manufacturer's warranty centre. We send you the
centre's address and help you book the repair.

documents.title: Warranty
documents.text:
## Who repairs the item
Every appliance has the manufacturer's warranty. Warranty repairs are done by the manufacturer's service centre,
not by Company X. Keep the warranty card and the invoice: the centre asks for both.
## How to make a claim
Call the service centre on the warranty card or bring the item to the centre. Most repairs take 7 to 14 days.
For fridges and washing machines a technician comes to your home.
## How long the warranty lasts
Small kitchen appliances such as kettles, blenders, toasters and rice cookers have 12 months. Fans, vacuum
cleaners and air purifiers have 24 months. Fridges, washing machines and air conditioners have 36 months.
## Extended warranty
At checkout you can add 12 more months of warranty for 10% of the item's price. The extended warranty covers the
same faults as the manufacturer's warranty and is handled by Company X.
## What is not covered
The warranty does not cover damage from drops, water, the wrong voltage or repairs by someone else. Filters and
other parts that wear out are not covered either.

documents.title: Delivery
documents.text:
## Delivery times
We deliver nationwide. Ho Chi Minh City and Ha Noi: 1-2 working days. Other provinces: 2-5 working days. Orders
placed after 4 pm count from the next working day.
## Delivery fee
The delivery fee is 45,000 VND per order. Delivery is free for orders over 1,000,000 VND.
## Tracking your order
When your order ships you get a text message with a tracking link. The link shows where the parcel is and the
name and phone number of the driver on the day of delivery.
## Large appliances
Fridges and washing machines are delivered by our own team in a 4-hour time slot that you choose at checkout.
The team carries the item to the room you want and removes the packaging.
## Late or missed deliveries
If the driver misses your time slot or the order is more than 3 days late, contact support with your order code.
We book a new slot and the driver calls 30 minutes before arrival. You may cancel a late order instead and get a
full refund with no fee.

documents.title: Changing or cancelling an order
documents.text:
## Order status
Your account shows the status of every order: confirmed, packed, shipped, delivered. You also get a text message
at each step.
## Before the order ships
The delivery address, the time slot and the payment method can be changed free of charge until the order ships.
An order that has not shipped can be cancelled at no cost in your account.
## Orders in several parcels
A large order may arrive in several parcels on different days. Each parcel has its own tracking link; the order
shows "delivered" only when the last parcel arrives.
## After the order ships
After shipping, the order can no longer be changed. Contact the carrier with the tracking number to ask for a new
address, or wait for delivery and use a change-of-mind return.

documents.title: Payments and refunds
documents.text:
## Ways to pay
We accept bank cards, bank transfer, e-wallets and cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up
to 10,000,000 VND.
## Monthly instalments
Orders over 3,000,000 VND can be paid in 3, 6 or 12 monthly instalments at 0% interest with partner banks. Choose
the instalment plan at checkout; the bank approves it within a few minutes.
## Invoices
A VAT invoice can be requested at checkout or within the same month. Write the company name, address and tax
code exactly as registered; the invoice is sent by email.
## Refund times
Refunds go back to the method you paid with: e-wallet within 3 working days, card or bank account within 7
working days. A double charge is refunded in 3-5 working days, depending on your bank.

documents.title: Air purifiers AP-20 and AP-40
documents.text:
## Which model for which room
The AP-20 is for rooms up to 30 m2 and the AP-40 for rooms up to 45 m2. Both have three fan speeds and a timer
from 1 to 8 hours.
## Air quality light
A light on the top shows the air quality: blue is good, yellow is fair and red is bad. In automatic mode the fan
speed follows the light.
## Filters
Each purifier comes with one filter. Filters are not washable: replace them every 6 months. The spare filter for
the AP-20 is HF-2013 (390,000 VND); for the AP-40 it is HF-4013 (450,000 VND).
## Cleaning and noise
Wipe the outside and the sensor with a dry cloth once a month. In night mode the AP-20 makes 24 dB and the AP-40
makes 28 dB, quieter than a whisper.

documents.title: Installation service
documents.text:
## What we install
Our technicians install washing machines, dishwashers and air conditioners. Fridges and other appliances need no
installation: the delivery team sets them up.
## Booking and price
Book the installation when you order. It costs 200,000 VND for a washing machine or dishwasher and 500,000 VND
for an air conditioner. It takes place within 3 days after delivery.
## Before the technician comes
Make sure there is a socket and a water tap near the place of the appliance. For an air conditioner, the outside
unit needs a wall or a balcony that the technician can reach safely.
## Taking away your old appliance
At the same visit the technician can take away your old appliance for free. Tell us when you book, so that the
team brings the right tools and a trolley.

documents.title: October delivery offer
documents.text:
## Free delivery in October
From 1 to 31 October 2026, delivery is free for all orders over 500,000 VND, in every province. Orders up to
500,000 VND pay the normal delivery fee. The offer cannot be combined with other delivery vouchers.
